releases.body:
# X360 Mobile 0.6.5 Hotfix 5

Maintenance update focused on game loading reliability and clearer driver diagnostics.

- Improved handling of extracted games, disc images and installed game containers.
- Added a per-game startup executable selector for games with multiple launchers.
- Improved reliability when loading additional game modules and title updates, with safer recovery after failed launches.
- Improved recognition of game files and preservation of launch preferences across library updates and shortcuts.
- More precise on-device Vulkan driver diagnostics, including the image check that failed and available error information.

Custom drivers remain device-dependent. More detailed diagnostics help investigate compatibility; they do not guarantee successful RADV loading or fix every game or mod.

Install over your current version; no uninstall is required. Keep a backup of your profiles and saves as usual.

Third alpha of the first PlayStation 5 emulator for Android. Fixes for the logs testers sent on v0.0.2, CPU work for Unreal Engine games, and more from KytyPS5. Existing installs are offered this update in the app.

**Fixed**
- Games that use fibers (sceFiber) closed the emulator at start on ARM ("Fiber context switching is only implemented on x86_64", Toy Story Retro Roundup). Fibers now switch the game's own registers. First support: please report how fiber games behave.

- Unity backtraces no longer follow a bogus frame at the start of each guest thread.

**New**
- Unreal Engine games: the TLS and process clock reads they make millions of times a second run inside the game code instead of calling into the emulator.
- Shaders can read the real GPU clock (S_MEMREALTIME) on drivers that offer it.
- JpegDec and JpegEnc libraries, and more

Tested on a Samsung Galaxy S26 (Exynos 2600, Xclipse 960, 12 GB) and a Galaxy S24 (Exynos 2400, Xclipse 940, 8 GB), both on Android 17.

# Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 — Release Notes

**2026-11-14 · Windows x64 · Linux x86_64 · macOS Intel**

Model 3-Vulkan v0.9.9.8 is a performance release. Nothing in the emulation model changed: every
game still renders the same picture it did in v0.9.9.6, and the same save states still load. What
changed is how much work the CPU and the GPU have to do to get there.

The headline is that the hybrid JIT now translates **more than 80 % of the guest instruction
stream to native x86-64**, the Vulkan renderer stopped paying for a redundant depth write that was
silently disabling hardware Early-Z / Hi-Z culling, and UMA GPUs finally get zero-copy geometry
upload. Together those turn the integrated-GPU experience from "lock it to 496×384" into a picture
that can actually be played at native resolution.

**Windows only.** This release contains a single asset for Windows x64. Everything else is
v0.9.8.6 unchanged.

## Why the v0.9.8.6 Windows package refused to start on AMD graphics cards

On Windows, AMD's Vulkan driver reports **128 bytes** of push constants — the amount Vulkan itself
guarantees. Every driver this renderer had been developed against reports 256.

# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 7

This QA build targets startup hangs on the AYN Thor and Retroid Pocket 5.

- Android now keeps the boot frontend and startup movies on the complete emulated presentation path.

- A false boot-time gameplay signal can no longer switch the following EA movie into native loading mode.
- A four-second watchdog completes only the first continuously stuck frontend movie. Later career movies are not affected.
- The stable app and stable update channel remain unchanged.

Use the System Driver first. Fully close the QA app between attempts and test at least five cold launches. On a successful test, confirm that you reached gameplay. On a failed test, attach the launcher diagnostics and full log to the existing device issue.

releases.name: Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6
releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 6

This QA build targets an intermittent early-boot hang reported on the Retroid Pocket 5.

The failed QA 5 diagnostic showed a live audio thread but no first presentation, native pipeline creation, scene target, or crash. The guest render thread stopped immediately after its first offscreen 2D captures.

QA 6 tightens the boot capture boundary:

- Only the four verified 2D vertex layouts and three supported primitive types are accepted.
- Individual and per-frame 2D payloads have conservative size limits.
- Invalid transient draw state is rejected before reading guest memory.
- The first twelve guest frames now log capture begin and completion markers.

Install QA 6 over the previous QA app, keep the System Driver selected, fully close the app between attempts, and test at least five launches. Attach diagnostics from any failed launch.

The stable app and stable update channel are unchanged. The APK includes no game data.

releases.body:
# Skate 3 Mobile v2.0.18 QA 5

This is an opt-in diagnostic build that installs over earlier **Skate 3 QA** builds and preserves QA app data.

## RP5 intermittent black-screen fix

QA 4 proved that the Retroid Pocket 5 can render the Quality profile's 1280x720 scene target, but testers reported that startup only succeeded roughly half the time.

The QA 4 profile copied Performance's visible feature settings, but one internal pipeline gate still used the profile number. Quality therefore compiled optional outline, spline, and shadow shader families even though those features were disabled. Cold and partially warmed shader caches could take different startup paths.

QA 5 fixes the mismatch:

- The 1280x720 Quality target remains enabled.
- The pipeline builder now follows the active lean-scene flag instead of assuming every Quality profile needs the full optional PSO set.
- Renderer installation applies the same defensive lean-feature guard.
- The startup log must report `lean Android set` for this QA Quality profile.
- Stable v2.0.17 and its update channel remain unchanged.

## RP5 test

1. Install QA 5 directly over QA 4.
2. Keep the System Driver selected.

### Changed

- **The game runs much cooler, at the same frame rate.** The game's threads used to keep CPU cores
  spinning flat out while they waited, for each other and for the GPU. Now they rest while they
  wait. This is on by default. On the AYN Thor at Frame rate 30, the hottest CPU core runs about
  21 C cooler and the handheld draws about a quarter less power.
- **Heat guard is now a section of its own in Settings**, with three options, each turned on or
  off by itself:

  - **Rest the CPU while the GPU draws** - on by default.
  - **Lower the frame rate when hot** - the old Heat guard, still off by default. It now steps in
    at temperatures an AYN Thor with its fan running actually reaches (the GPU at 75 C or a CPU
    core at 88 C). Before, it waited for 90 C on the GPU and never acted.
- **A diagnostic record of the game's functions is now kept only in Debugging Mode**, for less
  CPU work.

# PokePark 2: Wonders Beyond, PC and Android port (beta) 0.1.2

No game data is included: you need your own copy of the game (USA, S2LE01).

## Downloads

- **Windows** (10 or 11, 64-bit; Vulkan 1.3 or OpenGL 3.3): unzip and run PokePark2.exe. Keep the prompts and tools folders, SDL3.dll and vcruntime140.dll beside it. If you're updating, unzip over your old folder; your saves and settings stay.
- **Android** (11 or later, arm64, Vulkan 1.3): install PokePark2.apk over the previous version. Your saves stay.

## What's new

- **Many more controllers on Windows.** PlayStation (DualShock 4, DualSense), Switch Pro, 8BitDo and most other controllers now work over USB or Bluetooth, read through SDL3, alongside Xbox ones. releases.body:
**Experimental build 0.3.108-alpha, not for general use.** Built from `e370fb1` (branch `steam-arm64`) on 2026-09-29. The regular build is at [apk-latest](https://github.com/cobrabm12/fexdroid/releases/tag/apk-latest).

What is new here:

- **Valve's native ARM64 Steam client** instead of the translated one: Settings › Game › "Native Steam client (experiment)" › Start. It downloads about 1 GB from Valve, installs apart from the regular Steam and asks you to sign in again. Games cannot be started from it yet.
  - Tested on a Xiaomi (Dimensity 7200, Android 16) up to 0.3.107: the client installs itself, runs and starts its web helper, then refused the web helper's connection because `lsof` was missing. 0.3.108-alpha has an `lsof` for native programs; with it the client draws its sign-in window on a PC. Not yet confirmed on a phone.
- **Frames straight from the game** (Settings › Performance, off by default): the game's picture skips the X server. Tested with vkcube only.
- The way every program of a session is started has changed. The regular Steam still starts with it (tested on the same Xiaomi).
